name: Runner Extras - Object Metadata System Table
brief: Issue #2519: Object Metadata (2000000071) is a real application-database table, not a virtual one. The runner has no application database, so it synthesises the row set from BC's own SystemTables.ApplicationDatabaseTables and leaves the compiled-metadata payload columns blank. This suite pins the synthesis and the blank payload so neither can change silently.
description: What Object Metadata CONTAINS - one row per application-database system table, Object Type = Table, nothing else - is plain BC behaviour, adjudicated upstream by the al-language corpus (record/TestObjectMetadataSystemTable.al). This suite deliberately asserts none of that twice. It asserts only what exists because this is the runner: that the rows appear at all without any application database behind them, and that the compiled-metadata payload columns (Metadata, User Code, User AL Code, Symbol Reference, Metadata Version, Hash, Object Subtype, Has Subscribers, Schema Hash) read blank rather than carrying a fabricated payload. The blank is a DECLARED divergence, recorded in docs/limitations.md; issue #2771 tracks making those columns refuse by name instead, which needs a per-field blob-read seam the shared TempTableDataProvider path does not have. Target is OnPrem, not Cloud: Microsoft declares Object Metadata Scope = OnPrem, so an AL object naming the record type cannot compile for Cloud (AL0296) - which is also why the upstream corpus test has to reach the table through RecordRef.
